component.name: GameGlass Hub
component.summary: Immersive touch experiences for the games you love

description.p: GameGlass Hub is the desktop companion for GameGlass. It pairs your phone or tablet with your PC and turns it into a second screen of touch controls for the games you play, so keybinds you would otherwise hunt for on the keyboard become buttons, dials and switches under your hand.

ul.li: Connect a phone or tablet to your PC over your local network and use it as a live control surface
Browse and install ready-made control sets, called Shards, for supported games
Build your own controls with Forge, a visual no-code editor
Send keystrokes, macros and virtual gamepad input to any game running on the PC
